answer: A single quartz per identity, enforced by toll-road transponder passage history: A toll operator signs the transponder's passage history across three different gantries in a month. A farm needs one vehicle with one transponder per copy, and a thousand transponders on the same gantry in the same minute is a convoy, not a crowd. That is the whole defence. The crystal a clone farm must spend is linear in its size, so the voyage it can extract per epoch is bounded by what it is willing to burn, and burning is the point.
